'''Fush Tournament LSC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 24 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 WHT Fush LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I need this deck to be tournament fit. Your comments are appreciated!

== Strategy ==

SOME COMMENTS/CARD CHOICES
- 16 character may sound as much, but some of them have OK destinies, so it shouldn't be a problem.
- Speak With The Jedi Council and Control/Tunnel Vision will help me pull the Council Chamber. The Chamber pulls Yoda who pulls my sense/alters.
- I've had a hard time figuring out the space package for this deck. How well will it do?
- Will this deck be destroyed buy the maintance killers?
- Your Insight/Stagin Areas makes their Jedi -1, and can also be ditched for Honor, should I need that.
- Leia's Blaster Rifle: Making opponents characters lost during weapons phase is always great.

CARDS THAT ALMOST MADE THE CUT
- Don't Get Cocky. Instead of a Jedi Presence
- Star Destroyer! I like sevens....
- Dash
- Luke w/Saber. Which Luke's should I go with? I'm not sure how big chances are he'll be going to space.
